scripts.dev: export COLUMNS="${COLUMNS:-120}"; export LINES="${LINES:-40}"; node ./node_modules/sanity/bin/sanity dev --port 3333
scripts.deploy: export COLUMNS="${COLUMNS:-120}"; export LINES="${LINES:-40}"; node ./node_modules/sanity/bin/sanity deploy
scripts.build: export COLUMNS="${COLUMNS:-120}"; export LINES="${LINES:-40}"; node ./node_modules/sanity/bin/sanity build
scripts.seed: export COLUMNS="${COLUMNS:-120}"; export LINES="${LINES:-40}"; node ./node_modules/sanity/bin/sanity exec ./scripts/seedDefaults.ts
scripts.dataset:export: mkdir -p backups && export COLUMNS="${COLUMNS:-120}"; export LINES="${LINES:-40}"; node ./node_modules/sanity/bin/sanity dataset export production ./backups/production-latest.ndjson --overwrite
